name: fl_fqhc_rates
description: Florida MEDICAID (not Medicare) FQHC per-visit PPS encounter rates by provider, from the Florida Agency for Health Care Administration. Returns each clinic's encounter rate for a semester (default latest; earlier semesters back to 2019 via period, e.g. "2024-10" or "October 2024") plus the statewide min/median/max/mean and the effective date. Filter by clinic name or Medicaid provider number.

provider.description: Clinic name fragment or Medicaid provider number.

limit.description: Max provider rows returned (default 25, max 200). Statewide stats always cover all providers.

name: fl_medicaid_rates
description: Florida Medicaid reimbursement rate schedules from the Florida Agency for Health Care Administration: FQHC, rural health clinic (RHC), provider-based RHC, nursing home per diem, skilled nursing unit, swing bed, hospice (level of care and room and board), and state mental health hospital per diem rates (community hospitals are paid by DRG/EAPG and are not in any schedule here). Per-provider rates with statewide min/median/max, effective date and earlier published semesters.

schedule.description: Which rate schedule. "hospital" is the state mental health hospital per diem table only (3 hospitals); community hospitals are paid by DRG/EAPG and are not published as rates here.

provider.description: Provider name fragment or Medicaid provider number.

name: fl_rate_periods
description: List which Florida Medicaid rate schedules exist and the effective periods published for each (e.g. October 2026, October 2025, October 2024 for FQHC).

schedule.description: One schedule, or omit for all.
